QUALITY_FEEDBACK.BLOCKING_DETAIL: This file needs corrections before it can be converted reliably.
QUALITY_FEEDBACK.LOSSLESS_DETAIL: The planned pipeline is lossless, so content should remain consistent after saving.

QUALITY_FEEDBACK.TEXT_ONLY_DETAIL: Expect readable content, but not layout, media, or advanced styling.
QUALITY_FEEDBACK.BEST_EFFORT_DETAIL: This conversion is useful but not faithful: structure or formatting may change noticeably.
QUALITY_FEEDBACK.TABLE_ONLY_DETAIL: This conversion prioritizes rows and columns. Content outside the table will not be represented well.
QUALITY_FEEDBACK.UNIFORM_DATA_DETAIL: The result is valid only if records and fields stay sufficiently uniform after flattening.
QUALITY_FEEDBACK.RESULT_DETAIL: Output generated. Use final size and expected reliability to decide whether a quick manual review is needed.

CONVERSION_VALIDATION.TEXT_ONLY: Only text content will be preserved. Layout, styles, and embedded media may be lost.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.BEST_EFFORT: This conversion may lose formatting or structure. Review the result before sharing it.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.TABLE_ONLY: The output is optimized for tabular data and will generate a table-focused result.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.REQUIRES_UNIFORM_DATA: This conversion works best with uniform records that share the same fields.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.INVALID_JSON: The selected file is not valid JSON, so this conversion cannot start.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.INVALID_XML: The selected file is not valid XML, so this conversion cannot start.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.JSON_ARRAY_OF_OBJECTS_REQUIRED: This conversion requires a JSON array of objects, for example [{"name":"Ada"}].
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.JSON_UNIFORM_KEYS_REQUIRED: This conversion requires JSON objects with the same fields in every row.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.HTML_TABLE_REQUIRED: Exporting HTML to CSV or XLSX requires at least one real HTML table with readable rows and cells.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.HTML_TABLE_MERGED_CELLS: This HTML table uses merged cells with rowspan or colspan. The export will flatten that structure, so review the output carefully.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.HTML_TABLE_NESTED: This HTML document contains nested tables. Only the outer table will be exported; nested table content is excluded from the tabular output.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.HTML_TABLE_COMPLEXITY: This HTML contains tables, and the selected target will flatten rows, columns, or merged cells. Review the output carefully.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.STRUCTURED_TABULAR_DATA_REQUIRED: This conversion requires uniform tabular records or a structure that can be flattened without nested arrays of objects.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.STRUCTURED_DATA_NORMALIZED: The content will be normalized into tabular columns with controlled flattening. Review final headers and values carefully.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.PDF_TEXT_REQUIRED: This PDF does not expose extractable text. If it comes from scans or images, text conversion cannot start reliably.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.PDF_TEXT_LIMITED: This PDF contains very little extractable text. The output may be incomplete or almost empty.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.MULTI_STEP_REVIEW: This conversion uses a multi-step pipeline already known to be fragile. Review the final structure and formatting carefully.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.TXT_NO_TABULAR_STRUCTURE: This text file does not contain enough lines to produce a meaningful CSV. At least two lines (header + data) are needed.
CONVERSION_VALIDATION.TXT_DELIMITER_UNCERTAIN: No consistent delimiter was detected in this text file. The conversion will attempt best-effort parsing, but the result may need manual adjustment.
